neighbours.label: the split-off verb prefix ' de' (' de'+'posed', ' de'+'plane', ' de'+'cont'+'amin'+'ated') and Cyrillic ' де', firing on that piece; French ' de', whole-word verbs and other words stay quiet
fire: After years of misrule, the king was deposed by his sons.
All the nurses had to be decontaminated after the spill.
Passengers wait in their seats until it is time to deplane.
Generals deposed the president in a bloodless coup.
Workers in the plant were decontaminated at the gate.
We will deplane at the rear of the aircraft.
The governor was deposed and sent into exile.
quiet: After years of misrule, the king was hated by his sons.
All the nurses had to be vaccinated after the spill.
Passengers wait in their seats until it is time to leave.
Generals praised the president in a long speech.
Il vient de la ville de Lyon.
We will board at the rear of the aircraft.
The governor was elected and sent to the capital.
